units.source_text: 暮色苍茫，笼罩着镇郊的道路岔口，

en.t: Dusk spread dim and vast, shrouding the fork in the road on the outskirts of town,

units.source_text: 三个孩子叽叽喳喳如鸟儿似的叫声，

en.t: the chatter of the three children, crying out like little birds,

units.source_text: 和姑娘向他们头上丢过去的橘子的鲜亮颜色——这所有的一切，

en.t: and the bright color of the oranges the girl had thrown over their heads, all of it,

units.source_text: 片刻之间就从车窗外消失了。

en.t: vanished from outside the train window in a single moment.

units.source_text: 但是这幅画面却深深的留在了我的心里，让我几乎喘不过气来。

en.t: But that scene remained deep in my heart, leaving me almost unable to breathe.

units.source_text: 我发现自己情不自禁的愉悦起来。

en.t: I found myself becoming happy in spite of myself.

units.source_text: 我抬起头，像看另外一个人似的重新打量那个姑娘。

en.t: I lifted my head and looked at the girl again, as though I were seeing a different person.

units.source_text: 不知何时，姑娘已经回到我对面的位置上了，

en.t: Before I knew it, the girl had already returned to the seat opposite me,

units.source_text: 淡绿色的围巾上面依然是她那布满皲裂的双颊，

en.t: and above her pale green scarf were still her cheeks covered with chapped cracks,

units.source_text: 抱着大包袱的手里仍然谨慎的捏着那张三等车票。

en.t: while in the hand holding the large bundle she still carefully pinched that third class ticket.
